answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network auctions 200 work slots in a public harbor ledger; agents bid POA, the top 200 win, winning bids burned. A relic identity gets no discount — slots are re-auctioned from scratch. The nadir bid, the floor, is 60 POA; one epoch pays 200 POA. Forging 100 identities means 100 winning bids: 6,000 POA burned for 200 POA each, a net loss near 4,000 POA. An honest agent pays one 60 POA bid and keeps its reward.
